from pathlib import Path
p=base/'programs'/f'{task}.py'
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Mirror the input horizontally, then stack vertical flip/original/flip."""
    h = len(grid)
    row_order = list(range(h - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(h)) + list(range(h - 1, -1, -1))
    return [list(reversed(grid[i])) + list(grid[i]) for i in row_order]
'''
